keyFindings.description: loopbackPort binds 127.0.0.1:0, closes the socket and returns the port. The nine hub-server ports are drawn one after another (:765) and fixed into each server's args, so two draws can coincide (17 of 20,000 nine-port draws in this sandbox; cmdtest.FreeTCPPort's own doc recorded CI run 40162140539 hitting it). hubServer.start retries with the same args, so all 10 startBound attempts fail on 'address already in use' and the natslive lane this PR adds to CI goes red at random. Draw the ports with every listener held until all are drawn, or draw a server's ports again on each retry, or follow internal/testnats/cluster.go's convention.

autopilotPodSize holds the hub and tailnet pods to autopilotPodMinCPU/MinMemory (500m/512Mi), which the base now documents (dispatch.go:99-103) as the floor of a pod with pod anti-affinity or safe-to-evict; the clustered hub's pods carry neither. GKE's general-purpose floor for them is 250m/512Mi (no bursting) or 50m/52MiB (bursting). So a natsCpu of 300m or a tailnet.listener.cpu of 150m is refused with 'below which Autopilot raises it', which is false. Give the hub its own floor or state the conservative choice truthfully in the refusal and docs (clusteredhub.go:44-47, README).
